    <bpmn:task id="dereg" name="Deregister at the GO" />
    <bpmn:task id="verify" name="Verify the deregistration" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="g1" name="Deregistration confirmed?" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="rejectEnd" name="Deregistration rejected" />
    <bpmn:task id="prepare" name="Prepare the readmission of the measuring point" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="g2" name="Continuation of operations required?" />
    <bpmn:task id="oblige" name="Oblige the MPOO to continue the operations" />

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="g3" />

    <bpmn:task id="informMpoo" name="Inform the MPOO about the end and the beginning of the assignment" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="split" />
    <bpmn:task id="informMspo" name="Inform the MSPO about the assignment of the GO" />
    <bpmn:task id="informSp" name="Inform the SP about the assignment of the GO" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="join" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="doneEnd" name="Assignment completed" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="dereg" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="dereg" targetRef="verify" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="verify" targetRef="g1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" name="no" sourceRef="g1" targetRef="rejectEnd" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f11" sourceRef="g3" targetRef="equip" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f12" sourceRef="equip" targetRef="assign" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f13" sourceRef="assign" targetRef="informMpoo" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f14" sourceRef="informMpoo" targetRef="split" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f16" sourceRef="split" targetRef="informSp" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f17" sourceRef="informMspo" targetRef="join" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f18" sourceRef="informSp" targetRef="join" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f19" sourceRef="join" targetRef="doneEnd" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
